summary.en: The Decoder reports investors are pushing back on Anthropic’s $1.5T valuation amid a tech sell-off. TechCrunch, citing Ramp data, says AI usage keeps climbing but spending has stalled.

title.zh: 百度开源 2800 亿参数的 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base 基础模型

summary.zh: 百度发布 ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base，为 2800 亿参数的 MoE 模型，在 33.5 万亿 token 上预训练，刻意不做微调，供开发者自行调优。
summary.en: Baidu released ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base, a 280B-parameter MoE model pre-trained on 33.5T tokens and shipped deliberately without fine-tuning for developers to adapt.

why.zh: 提供未微调的大型开源底座，利于研究与定制。
why.en: An un-tuned large open base model is useful for research and customization.

sources.title: Baidu releases ERNIE 5.5 Flash Base with 280 billion parameters as an open-source foundation model

title.zh: OpenAI 发布网络安全模型 GPT-6 Cyber
title.en: OpenAI launches cybersecurity model GPT-6 Cyber

summary.zh: OpenAI 推出 GPT-6 Cyber，用于发现可利用漏洞、开发利用并建议补丁，训练使其保持在授权范围内。TechCrunch 追问这是否足以应对外界对 AI 实验室网络安全工作的审视。
summary.en: OpenAI introduced GPT-6 Cyber to find exploitable vulnerabilities, develop exploits and suggest patches, trained to stay within authorized scope. TechCrunch asks whether that is enough amid scrutiny of AI labs’ security work.

why.zh: 攻防两用的安全模型，同时把“守边界”作为卖点。
why.en: A dual-use security model that makes staying in scope a headline feature.

sources.title: OpenAIs GPT-6 Cyber can both break into systems and propose how to fix them
GPT‑6 Cyber: Advancing the frontier of aligned cybersecurity agents
OpenAI released a new cybersecurity model. Is that enough?

title.zh: Perplexity 推出常驻智能体 Teammates

summary.zh: Perplexity 推出 Teammates，在各自的虚拟机上自主推进长期项目的常驻智能体，需要 Max 套餐。
summary.en: Perplexity launched “Teammates”, always-on agents that work through ongoing projects on their own virtual machines; it requires the Max plan.

why.zh: 搜索公司转向长期运行的自主智能体。
why.en: A search company moves into long-running autonomous agents.

sources.title: Perplexity now has its own always-on AI agent

title.zh: Meta Muse 推出 Spaces，并支持与 Muse 头像视频通话
title.en: Meta adds Spaces to Muse and video chat with the Muse avatar

summary.zh: Meta 为 Muse 加入 Spaces，让助手构建定制的应用式界面；美国用户还可与 Muse 动画头像视频通话。
summary.en: Meta added “Spaces” to Muse so the assistant can build customized app-like experiences, and US users can now video chat with a Muse animated avatar.

why.zh: 消费级助手向可自建界面与拟人交互扩展。
why.en: Consumer assistants expand toward self-built interfaces and avatar interaction.

title.zh: NVIDIA 发布 Cosmos 3 开放模型，用于交互式世界模拟
title.en: NVIDIA releases Cosmos 3 open models for interactive world simulation

summary.zh: NVIDIA 在 Hugging Face 发布新的 Cosmos 3 开放模型，面向交互式世界模拟。
summary.en: NVIDIA published new Cosmos 3 open models on Hugging Face for interactive world simulation.

why.zh: 为机器人与仿真提供开放的世界模型底座。
why.en: Offers an open world-model base for robotics and simulation.

title.zh: Palo Alto Networks 拟以 5 亿美元收购 AI 智能体安全初创 Clutch
title.en: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy agent-security startup Clutch for $500M

summary.zh: 据消息人士，Palo Alto Networks 正洽谈以约 5 亿美元收购 Clutch，后者上次估值为 8500 万美元。
summary.en: Per a source, Palo Alto Networks is in talks to buy Clutch for about $500M; Clutch was last valued at $85M.

why.zh: 智能体安全成为并购热点。
why.en: Agent security is becoming an M&A hot spot.

sources.title: Palo Alto Networks in talks to buy AI agent security startup Clutch for $500M
